svg.title: Direct managed-identity access to Dataverse
svg.desc: Three setup and access steps, not three required token exchanges. First, an authorized administrator or deployment process registers the user-assigned managed identity's Application ID as a Dataverse application user with a custom read-only role in each approved environment. Second, the Function requests a token for the target Dataverse environment using that managed identity. Third, Dataverse authorizes reads through the application user's security roles. Federation through a separate app registration and tenant-wide discovery are optional, separate designs.
svg.text: Onboard permissions first. Keep privileged setup separate from collection.

g.text: Register its Application ID as an application user in each approved environment.
Assign a custom read-only role. Use an authorized administrator or deployment process.
The Function authenticates with its user-assigned managed identity.
Target the correct Dataverse environment. A separate federated app is not required.
Dataverse applies the application user's security roles to transcript and metadata reads.
Tenant-wide discovery and environment onboarding are separate permissions and workflows.
